title: FURminator Sensitive Areas Tool – Worth It for Faces & Paws?
description: We used the FURminator Sensitive Areas tool on our dog's face, ears and paws for 3 weeks. It reached the spots the full-size deshedder can't and cleared the loose fur around the eyes without any flinching. Honest take on whether it earns a place in your grooming kit. 🐾 #doggrooming #furminator #dogcare #petproducts #sheddingdog
